create_blenderbot_config: create a BlenderbotConfig instance with default facebook/blenderbot-3B style configuration parameters
init_blenderbot_model: initialize a BlenderbotModel with random weights from a BlenderbotConfig instance
access_model_config: access a model's configuration object via the model.config attribute
configure_encoder_decoder: configure a BlenderbotConfig as an encoder-decoder model with separate encoder and decoder layer counts
set_token_ids: set pad_token_id, bos_token_id, eos_token_id, decoder_start_token_id, and forced_eos_token_id on BlenderbotConfig
